decisions.why_preserve: Independent scratch-trained 400M total top-1 MoE (19M active), unique training state and router code; research on efficient routing. F32 master survives even if BF16 conversions are reproducible.
decisions.alternative: Existing Liquid/LFM3 hybrid and Tiny drafter are differently trained/architected, not functional substitutes for Aurora routing. FP16/BF16 Aurora conversion copies excluded.
decisions.uncertainty: Publisher only 100B training tokens and 36h RTX PRO 6000 claim; short 2048 context, base-only non-assistant, source training datasets and FlexAttention runtime unverified.

decisions.why_preserve: Independent multifunctional tiny visual perception trained outcome distinct from much larger OCR and VLMs; native compressed 21MB cact plus F32 safetensors 216MB under same logical ID. Pinned Windows/Linux Cactus 4.1.4 native runtime and repo source make future offline study possible.
decisions.alternative: PaddleOCR-VL1.5 and WeVisOne-VL work in larger VLM regime, not minimal structured spatial/segmentation decision on phones; retain existing source without replacement.
decisions.uncertainty: No total tensor census on HF for Mirage, reviewer vendor claims 51.3M; 74ms Samsung Galaxy S26 NPU and 107ms CPU lack independently verified clocks/batch/runtime; standalone binaries untrusted until static review.

decisions.why_preserve: This exact parent f83d2b0a is referenced by independently edited safety model and is full post-trained image/video QnA BF16 original. Later HF code revision has same weight SHA, but recipe exact parent revision preserves historical reconstruction.
decisions.alternative: Existing LFM3-1.7B-Base and Omni2B are not the same trained image/video model, so neither is an equivalent substitute.
decisions.uncertainty: LFM Open License v1.0 annual 10 million USD revenue threshold for commercial use; parent code remote Python, ABI/owner hardware and full offline restoration untested.

decisions.why_preserve: Actual independent refusal-direction edited language tower with BF16 SHA different from publisher training parent; completely independent from full original but shares unchanged custom code and tokenizer; preserve BF16 original + 1 Q4_K_M text GGUF + 1 F16 vision projector as one logical trained outcome; author published exact Heretic1.4.0 and pinned parent/harmless-harmful datasets config.
decisions.alternative: 14 extra GGUF quantizations are not distinct training and excluded; earlier Inkling tiny edit LoRA is a different architecture and multimodal editing technique.
decisions.uncertainty: Author 100-request refusal set 98 vs 3 and 14042-question text MMLU accuracy difference 34.37 vs 34.44 not conclusive, no independent image quality. LFM $10m annual commercial license clause and owner code ABI/parent local SHA unverified.
